scope: Source-bound codec, fixed command frames and portable normalized metadata query; no native transport, target IO or image link.

diagnostic_policies.ocr_policy: Require overlap with3.2-3.4V nominal window; not a measured-rail or full-tolerance acceptance test.
diagnostic_policies.sdhc_sdxc_capacity: Reported CSDv2 bit-field capacity only, not a full SD conformance test.
diagnostic_policies.unknown_csd: Preserve raw response and reject unsupported structures; SDUC is not SPI-compatible.
diagnostic_policies.cmd0: Changes protocol state and can interrupt pending programming. Portable query requires exclusive cold-start declaration exactly1, does not prove actual ownership and has no reset/retry after failure.
diagnostic_policies.query_deadlines: Engineering bench policies, checked at subsequent polls; cannot preempt a callback which never returns. Native finite register/wire timing budgets remain unimplemented.

open_items: Native bounded SPI3 transport and register/pin/clock provenance are unimplemented; portable query exists and is tested only against a normalized host model.
Actual SPI/card behavior, physical ownership, clock/CS timing, power/retention, latency/endurance/power loss and logger integration remain unqualified.
No connection or protocol command was sent to a real card. No media block read, write, erase, lock or format path exists in this codec.
